checks.message: Verify min and max capacity limits prevent runaway scaling and unexpected costs
checks.context: A misconfigured scalable target with no max limit can scale to hundreds of instances during a traffic spike or attack, causing massive unexpected charges.

checks.message: All instances in the group will be terminated on deletion
checks.context: Deleting an Auto Scaling group terminates all EC2 instances it manages unless you detach them first with --force-delete. Running instances, their EBS volumes, and any in-progress scaling activities are affected.

checks.message: Resuming scaling processes may trigger immediate scaling actions
checks.context: If the group's desired capacity diverged while processes were suspended, resuming may immediately launch or terminate instances to reconcile. Verify desired vs actual count before resuming.

checks.message: Verify min-size is not being set to 0 — this terminates all instances
checks.context: Setting min-size=0 and desired-capacity=0 immediately terminates all instances in the group. For production workloads this causes a complete outage. Double-check the values before applying.
